title: Impossible to level
text: Impossible to level. While this is nice looking and a good idea in theory, it doesn't account for several issues. I am not an expert, but can manage simple DIY. This just couldn't be managed! It is built to have extensive adjustability for various size microwaves, but that is also its downfall. I could level the main brackets to the wall. But as the arm brackets drop down, there is not a solid enough end feel to keep the microwave from leaning. The "give" which allows sizing, forces the brackets to sag making the microwave hang uneven no matter what I tried. You may be more skilled than I am, but after 2 hours of messing with it, I gave up. Every piece is fixed with tiny screws and adjustments mean removing the screws and changing the whole thing! Also, what is the deal? It is so sharp on the edges, I finally put gloves on to protect my hands. Seriously?
